title: NIST AI RMF - MITRE ATLAS - OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Deterministic Control Mapping
author: Shibin Antony

nist_ai_rmf.description: Mechanisms are in place to prioritize AI risks and apply appropriate risk management interventions to AI inputs.

implementation.control_plane_rule: Deterministic delimiter segregation and multi-turn prompt classifier evaluation before inference forwarding.
implementation.content_plane_action: Sanitize and strip adversarial delimiter overrides; reject prompts exceeding prompt-shield classifier confidence threshold (>0.75).

nist_ai_rmf.description: AI systems are evaluated for privacy risks and information exposure prior to deployment and in runtime.

implementation.control_plane_rule: Token output inspection against regex registries and cryptographic canary tokens.
implementation.content_plane_action: Redact detected PII, API tokens, RSA keys, and halt generation if canary signature matches.

cloud_agnostic_enforcement.aws_bedrock_guardrails: SensitiveInformationPolicy: PII entities [EMAIL, IP_ADDRESS, US_SSN] -> ANONYMIZE

nist_ai_rmf.description: Organizational risk tolerance for AI system confidentiality and proprietary instructions is established.

implementation.control_plane_rule: Zero-trust system role isolation; evaluate output similarity against known system prompt embeddings.
implementation.content_plane_action: Suppress output if cosine similarity with system prompt text exceeds 0.80.

mappings.control_name: Agentic Tool Execution & Identity Boundary Enclosure

nist_ai_rmf.description: Accountability structures are established for downstream actions taken by automated AI agents.

implementation.control_plane_rule: Deterministic schema enforcement, JSON parameter validation, and IAM scoped step-up credential issuance.
implementation.content_plane_action: Reject tool calls attempting destructive actions (DROP, DELETE, SHELL, WIRE) without external HITL cryptographic token.

nist_ai_rmf.description: AI systems are monitored and evaluated for vulnerabilities to untrusted third-party multimodal and RAG data.

implementation.control_plane_rule: Pre-RAG ingestion scanner for hidden instructions, zero-width spaces, and base64 encoded overrides in retrieved documents.
implementation.content_plane_action: Sanitize retrieved context chunks through intermediate sanitization proxy prior to prompt synthesis.

cloud_agnostic_enforcement.azure_ai_content_safety: PromptShield: documentAnalysis (indirect prompt injection detection enabled)
cloud_agnostic_enforcement.aws_bedrock_guardrails: ContextualGroundingPolicy: Filters untrusted context hallucination / injection
